subject.title: Code health audit: gollaw default gate clean in PR #294

question: Should maintainers keep this broad Gollaw audit as the tracker for https://github.com/openclaw/wacli/pull/294, split verified findings into narrower issues, or decline analyzer-score-driven cleanup tracking?
rationale: The issue combines legitimate hardening, maintainability cleanup, external analyzer calibration, and compatibility-sensitive refactors, so automation cannot choose the permanent scope safely.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Through PR Review
options.body: Leave this issue open while the linked draft PR is repaired, proven, and reviewed as the candidate implementation.

options.title: Split Verified Findings
options.body: Create narrower follow-ups for confirmed security, dead-code, duplication, and large-function work, then close this umbrella after links preserve the context.

options.title: Decline Broad Audit Tracking
options.body: Close the audit if maintainers do not want score-driven analyzer reports tracked without independently actionable repository changes.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Through PR Review
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open while the linked draft PR is repaired, proven, and reviewed as the candidate implementation.
